great-crucible.png.name: Great crucible
great-crucible.png.description: The mega forge's head: a colossal tilting crucible on its working platform, its control core housed on its west flank and its spout pouring east onto the line.

great-crucible-melt.png.name: Great crucible melt
great-crucible-melt.png.description: Overlay: the great crucible's melt and its spout's run, drawn over its body so the engine can pulse it.

furnace-core.png.name: Furnace control core
furnace-core.png.description: The great crucible's control core, cut free and lying on its transport skid: the prize.

tapping-furnace.png.name: Tapping furnace
tapping-furnace.png.description: The pour line's tapping furnace: a domed refractory roof ringed by charging ports, its taphole and spout trough running south toward the crane bay.

tapping-furnace-melt.png.name: Tapping furnace melt
tapping-furnace-melt.png.description: Overlay: the melt in the tapping furnace's taphole and spout trough, so the engine can pulse it.

cooling-rack.png.name: Cooling stack
cooling-rack.png.description: An automated cooling stack: heavy shelf beams with its stacker carriage parked on the rail along its west side, empty.

cooling-rack-castings.png.name: Cooling stack with castings
cooling-rack-castings.png.description: The cooling stack with castings left in field cradles on four of its shelves when the work stopped.

pour-head.png.name: Pour head
pour-head.png.description: The line's pour head module: an armoured nozzle unit on four clamps. A b3 haul.

mould-master.png.name: Mould master
mould-master.png.description: The line's mould master module: a precision block with four master pattern faces. A b3 haul.

fallen-girder.png.name: Fallen runway beam
fallen-girder.png.description: A gantry runway beam fallen across the bay floor under its runway, its east end sheared with torn cables: the hall's best cover.

pallet-bay.png.name: Pallet bay marking
pallet-bay.png.description: Worn bay markings for dispatch: four corner brackets and a bay label bar, the rest transparent. Lay side by side for a row of bays.

trench-cover.png.name: Trench cover
trench-cover.png.description: Chequer-plate covers over a service trench between steel kerbs. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

drain-gutter.png.name: Drain gutter
drain-gutter.png.description: A slotted drain channel in floor plate. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

floor-drain.png.name: Floor drain
floor-drain.png.description: A square floor drain grate in its frame.

crane-runway.png.name: Gantry runway
crane-runway.png.description: Overhead: a gantry runway box beam with a copper linear-drive stator strip, a column cap at its middle. Drawn above units. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly every 4 cells.

cable-tray.png.name: Cable tray
cable-tray.png.description: Overhead: a ladder cable tray with its cables. Drawn above units. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

cable-tray-fallen.png.name: Fallen cable tray
cable-tray-fallen.png.description: A cable tray fallen to the floor, bent, its cables spilled.

oil-stain.png.name: Oil stain
oil-stain.png.description: An old dark oil stain on the floor. Overlay, laid along the traffic.

oil-trail.png.name: Oil trail
oil-trail.png.description: A trail of oil drips and smears along a traffic lane, north-south.

coolant-stain.png.name: Coolant stain
coolant-stain.png.description: A dried coolant spill, crusted pale blue-green.

scorch-mark.png.name: Scorch mark
scorch-mark.png.description: A heat scorch on the floor, sooty with a burnt-steel fringe.

scorch-arc.png.name: Arc burn
scorch-arc.png.description: An electrical arc burn: a blast star with forked burn lines, for a blown cabinet.

line-pulpit.png.name: Line pulpit
line-pulpit.png.description: The line's control pulpit seen from above: its armoured roof, visor strip along its south edge. Where b2 wakes the line.

recorder-console.png.name: Recorder console
recorder-console.png.description: A line recorder console: dead screen at its north end, a data-core socket, an amber status bar. b2's recorder.

mag-rail.png.name: Mag-rail
mag-rail.png.description: The feed mag-rail sunk flush in floor plate: a ribbed trough between guide rails, copper coil rings across it. A run: lay copies end to end north-south (rotate for east-west); it repeats seamlessly. Also the slag skid's lane.

mag-rail-curve.png.name: Mag-rail curve
mag-rail-curve.png.description: The mag-rail turning a quarter circle, meeting a straight rail at its south and east edges.

mag-rail-end.png.name: Mag-rail end
mag-rail-end.png.description: The end of a mag-rail: a decelerator coil block at its north end, the rail running out of its south edge.

feed-pod.png.name: Feed capsule pod
feed-pod.png.description: A sealed feed capsule pod riding the mag-rail, its nose a dim charge window: the furnace's charge.

feed-pod-derailed.png.name: Derailed feed pod
feed-pod-derailed.png.description: The feed capsule thrown off its rail askew, a band split, ore spilled.

slag-skid.png.name: Hover slag skid
slag-skid.png.description: A hover slag skid on four lift-fan rings, a slag pot on its spine.

slag-skid-melt.png.name: Slag skid glow
slag-skid-melt.png.description: Overlay: the glowing crack in the slag skid's crust.

slag-skid-crashed.png.name: Crashed slag skid
slag-skid-crashed.png.description: The slag skid crashed at the slag pit's lip, a fan ring torn off, its pot tipped east. Lay it with its east edge on the pit's edge.

slag-skid-crashed-spill.png.name: Slag skid spill
slag-skid-crashed-spill.png.description: Overlay: the slag running out of the tipped pot to its east edge, into the pit.

thrust-wash.png.name: Thrust wash
thrust-wash.png.description: Faint scorch streaks from hover skids' lift fans, north-south, laid along their lanes.

ladle-lift.png.name: Ladle in its manipulator
ladle-lift.png.description: A pouring ladle in the clamp yoke of an overhead manipulator, full of melt. Overhead: drawn above units.

ladle-lift-tipped.png.name: Ladle tipped mid-pour
ladle-lift-tipped.png.description: The manipulator holding the ladle tipped mid-pour, its bowl near empty. Overhead: drawn above units.

ladle-lift-tipped-pour.png.name: Ladle pour
ladle-lift-tipped-pour.png.description: Overlay: the melt pouring from the tipped ladle's lip.

finishing-cell.png.name: Finishing cell
finishing-cell.png.description: A robotic finishing cell: a robot arm on its turret plinth reaching to a clamped casting.

metrology-bed.png.name: Metrology bed
metrology-bed.png.description: A metrology bed with its scanning arch across it.
